_comment: Berlin GLE profile - the defaults baked into agent.py, kept here so switching BACK is also one command. hybrid=true per grok Aug 14 (GLE 350de-class PHEV claim); note today's real OBD read returned NO hybrid SoC PID from this car, so the flag is aspirational until a read proves it.
